sections.content: Real programs split into modules — separate files you import to reuse functions without copy-paste.
Imports give you access to the standard library (math, dates, HTTP) and your own shared code. Organizing code into modules keeps projects maintainable.
Key points: import only what you need, name collisions are possible, and circular imports break programs — keep dependencies one-directional.
